summary_en: KI-STAR REAL ESTATE raised FY2027 March period-end dividend forecast by 20 yen per share to 95 yen, from the previous 75 yen, following earlier-than-planned achievement of medium-term profit targets. Anniversary shareholder gifts of electronic money (2,000–10,000 yen depending on holdings) will be provided to shareholders on the March 31, 2027 register.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) and Implementation of Anniversary Shareholder Gift
translation_en_brief:
KI-STAR REAL ESTATE announced on November 12, 2026, that it will increase its FY2027 March period-end dividend forecast by 20 yen per share to 95 yen, up from the previous forecast of 75 yen. This brings the full-year dividend to 170 yen per share, compared to the prior forecast of 150 yen. The company's policy is to adjust annual dividends in line with profit growth while retaining sufficient capital for business expansion.

The dividend increase reflects the company's achievement of profit targets under its current medium-term plan one year ahead of schedule. As a result, the company announced the formulation of a new "Medium-Term Management Plan 2030" on the same date. Management views the increase as part of an active shareholder return strategy.

Additionally, to mark the 10th anniversary of the company's listing on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market in December 2016, KI-STAR REAL ESTATE will provide anniversary shareholder gifts of electronic money to all shareholders on the register as of March 31, 2027, regardless of holding period. Gift amounts range from 2,000 yen for shareholders holding 200–299 shares to 10,000 yen for those holding 1,000 or more shares. Shareholders meeting the one-year continuous holding requirement will receive anniversary gifts in addition to regular shareholder gifts.
